prompt: The client asks why the release needs a staging environment first. Explain it simply.

task.prompt: Write one or two sentences the client would understand.
task.context: Client: Why can't you just put it live straight away? It seems like extra work.

rubric.label: Explains staging correctly
rubric.description: A private copy of the app where changes are tested first.

rubric.label: Plain words, no jargon
rubric.description: No terms like environment parity or pipeline.

rubric.label: Says why it protects them
rubric.description: Customers never see a bug that testing would have caught.

task.sampleAnswer: Staging is a private copy of your app where we test changes first, so your customers never see a bug we could have caught.
